# For someone cloning.

```
cd zk-medium
forge install foundry-rs/forge-std
forge build 
```

---

# How to Build.

```
1. From zk-easy/, export the real Solidity verifier.

     snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier multiplier_final.zkey verifier.sol

2. Scaffold a Foundry project and copy the generated file in
   unchanged.

     forge init zk-medium --no-git
     cd zk-medium
     cp ../../code1/zk-easy/verifier.sol src/Verifier.sol

3. Set solc = "0.8.36" under [profile.default] in foundry.toml — if
   the generated contract targets a different pragma, adjust the pin
   to match what it actually declares rather than editing the
   generated file itself.

4. Convert the real proof.json/public.json from Easy into the
   calldata shape `verifyProof` expects (snarkjs can do this
   directly):

     snarkjs zkey export soliditycalldata public.json proof.json

   Copy the printed `a`, `b`, `c`, and public input values directly
   into the test file's own Solution below.

5. Create the one test file from the Solution below, filling in the
   real values from step 4.

6. Build and run.

     forge build
     forge test -vv --gas-report
```
